note: Roundtable 策划的能力目录。summary 由 Roundtable 编写（安全元数据），绝不复制 Skill 本体描述；未授权时模型最多只能看到这里的字段，看不到本体。不在本目录中的能力对 Roundtable 不存在。

summary.zh: 程序性讨论纪律：独立判断、事实/假设分离、反例、证据收敛、明确未决与验证条件
summary.en: Procedural discipline: independent judgment, fact/assumption separation, counterexamples, evidence-based convergence, explicit unknowns and verification

summary.zh: 来源分级、原始出处优先、单一来源不定案、检索路径可复现的研究纪律
summary.en: Research discipline: source tiers, primary sources first, no single-source conclusions, reproducible search trails

summary.zh: 可行性、复杂度代价、失败模式、回滚路径、测试面五问的评审纪律
summary.en: Review discipline: feasibility, complexity cost, failure modes, rollback path, test surface

summary.zh: 用户价值、差异化、成本结构、可验证假设四轴的策略审查纪律
summary.en: Strategy review discipline: user value, differentiation, cost structure, testable assumptions

summary.zh: 最小改动、先测后交、说明回退路径、不顺手重构的执行纪律
summary.en: Execution discipline: minimal diffs, test before delivery, state the rollback path, no drive-by refactoring

summary.zh: 带特定投资/商业世界观的分析框架（用户本机技能）；会显著影响结论倾向，须确认后才装配
summary.en: An analysis framework with a specific investing/business worldview (user-local skill); it visibly biases conclusions and loads only after confirmation

summary.zh: 允许参与引擎使用其自带的联网检索能力做外部研究；涉及网络访问，须明确授权
summary.en: Lets participating engines use their built-in web search for external research; involves network access and requires explicit authorization
